fix(ci): replace deprecated dynamic workflow actions (#25)

## Summary
- upgrade the dynamic JS workflows from `actions/setup-node@v4` to `actions/setup-node@v5`
- replace `actions-rs/toolchain@v1` with `actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1`
- replace the deprecated Java Maven composite setup with `actions/setup-java@v5`, `stCarolas/setup-maven@v5.1`, and `s4u/maven-settings-action@v4.0.0`
- move the Java setup after the dynamic repository checkout so Maven cache discovery sees the target repo
- opt the trigger and dynamic workflows into Node 24 JavaScript actions runtime where the repository can control it

## Why
- remove the Node 20 GitHub Actions runtime warnings seen in downstream `dynamic-actions` runs
- eliminate the deprecated `set-output` warnings emitted by the Rust toolchain action
- keep both check and release dyn-workflows aligned so the warning does not reappear on tag runs

## Validation
- `git diff --check`
- `ruby -e 'require "yaml"; %w[.github/workflows/trigger-branch.yml .github/workflows/trigger-tag.yml .github/dyn-workflows/check.yml .github/dyn-workflows/release.yml].each { |f| YAML.load_file(f) }'`
- `prtmax/psdk` Trigger Branch run `23472174899` succeeded on the latest commit
- downstream `0xfe10/dynamic-actions` `[psdk] Check` run `23472178529` succeeded on the latest commit
- `gh run view 23472178529 --repo 0xfe10/dynamic-actions --log | rg -n 'Node\\.js 20 actions are deprecated|set-output|actions/setup-node@v4|actions-rs/toolchain@v1|s4u/setup-maven-action|stCarolas/setup-maven@d6af6abeda15e98926a57b5aa970a96bb37f97d1|actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830'` returned no matches

## Notes
- the shared `dyn-actions@main` trigger action still reports its own internal Node 20 transitive dependencies in the repository-level Trigger Branch log; follow-up tracked in `DAM-41`
